text:
emily: Quick heads-up  CloudForge just DM'd: their demo appliance is stuck in customs, ETA unknown. They asked if we can flip to a hybrid pattern (remote demo + BrightPath in-person walkthrough). Thoughts?
raj: Oof. Which session are we talking about?
lena: 11:30 hands-on slot at Track 2 (marketplace integrations). CloudForge was bringing 4 units for breakout labs.
emily: Right. They propose streaming their demo (remote) into the lab and having BrightPath run a live walkthrough using our spare kit. Need to check kit counts and AV slots.
dave: We have 5 spare kits in locker 3. But BrightPath needs a specific PCIe passthrough dongle for NVMe isolation. Do we have those?
brightpath-partner: BrightPath here  we can do a partial walkthrough without passthrough (software-only). Prefer to have one passthrough for the deep demo but can adapt.
emily: Good to know. Ops-bot: checklist for hybrid partner demos?
ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template located at /runbooks/partner-demos/v2.md. Reminder: pre-cache partner video on AV laptop and set OBS scene named "partner-hybrid" 30m prior.
raj: AV note  we should set up redundant ingest: RTMP from partner + SRT fallback to our relay. Alex from AV can handle.
lena: Also: swag. CloudForge's customs delay affects 120 promo tins bound for the Track 2 table. If BrightPath wants to use our tins, we need customs paperwork if they cross the booth boundary. Any legal constraints?
emily: Legal said we can redistribute partner swag at event if partners sign the local manifest. BrightPath needs to sign a transfer form. I can generate one.
dave: Shipping ops: can we swap 60 tins to Track 2 and 60 remain at main booth? How fast can courier re-label?
radh: (typo)
raj: Sam from courier said 45min for a manifest swap if labels are printed. Lena can you print?
lena: Printing now. Also update QR flow: attendees who scan Track 2 QR should get CloudForge asset link; if remote, swap to BrightPath follow-up form.
emily: Marketing ask: CloudForge wanted the co-announcement to go live once demo completes. If they go remote, timing still ok but need final approval from legal for copy. Can someone own the sync?
brightpath-partner: We can coordinate with your marketing team. If CloudForge wants to delay the announcement until their hardware arrives, notify us.
emily: Raj, can you own announcement sync (legal + marketing)?
raj: On it. I'll loop in KM and legal. Tentative plan: hold announcement until 3pm or proceed with joint "preview" note.
dave: Speaker logistics: we need a 20-min dry run with CloudForge remote presenter at 11:00. Can we do that?
emily: I'll schedule 11:00 test. Alex/AV please confirm RTMP creds for their engineer.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduled AV test reminder at 11:00 for room Track 2 and standby room.
lena: Volunteers: need 1 floater for BrightPath install and 2 people for QR troubleshooting. Can anyone fill?
raj: I can float for the first 10 mins. Dave can take QR.
dave: Yep. Also adding a step to runbook: if remote stream drops, press last-resort button -> play pre-recorded demo (5:30) stored on AV laptop (/av/cache/cloudforge-fallback.mp4).
emily: Great. Final runbook action items: 1) Pre-cache fallback video (Alex/AV) 2) Print swapped swag manifests and labels (Lena) 3) Courier manifest update (Sam) 4) BrightPath sign transfer form (BrightPath) 5) Legal review for announcement copy (Raj) 6) 11:00 dry-run test (Emily/AV). Reply when complete.
brightpath-partner: Signed transfer form incoming now.
lena: Manifests printed + labels ready; courier ETA 40m.
dave: Passthrough adapter located in locker 3; leaving it with BrightPath at 10:45.
emily: All right team  thanks. We'll treat this as a rehearsal in case cloud partners go remote. I'll post final updated runbook link after 10:30. :rocket:
